display_placement_convention: Label-preserving similarity, orientation reversing in these recorded coordinate conventions. This is a recipe placement, not a spinor rotation or state identification.
belt_stitch_rule: Two nearest lower vertices per upper vertex; include the reciprocal lower triangles; orient outward.
belt_matching_rule: First lexicographic adjacent-face matching closed by the recorded C3 coordinate cycle.
belt_branch_rule: chi is the sign of the face centroid Y; cyclic modes are conjugated when chi is negative.
spinor_rule: P_i=(I-chi_i n_i.sigma)/2 with outward Euclidean unit normals; compute S=sum P_i and N_ij=P_i S^-1 P_j.
retention_rule: Retain seed, geometry, face labels, signs and frame conventions through every reconstruction. Do not attempt to reconstruct them from a final state vector.
scope: Explicit recipe for the currently retained four constructions. Choices are supplied by existing constructors, not derived from an unmarked point or a physical uniqueness law.
